profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Netflix | Computer Science (BS) and Operations Management (BBA) Dual Degree @ UMass Amherst
profile.summary:
Hi there! 👋 

My name is Emily, and I’m a Computer Science (BS) and Operations and Information Management (BBA) Dual Degree recipient at University of Massachusetts Amherst interested in pursuing a career in product management or software engineering. I am currently a software engineer working at Netflix on the Android Client Foundations team. I was previously a project manager and team lead with the Center for Youth Engagement. I also had two prior software engineering internships, where I contributed code directly alongside senior software engineers. I’m passionate about web-development, providing high quality code that improves product usability and user experience. With my business background, I’m able to provide a second business perspective to product decisions as well as communicate and collaborate effectively across teams. I’m looking to grow and build my skills as a software developer, as well as position myself in a role where my experience with both business processes and software engineering can combine into one.

positions.title: Software Engineer L4
positions.description: Software engineer working on the Netflix app for Android

positions.title: Software Engineer L3
positions.description: New graduate software engineer working on the Android Client Foundations team

positions.title: Engineering Lead/Project Manager
positions.description:
Contribute to Project RAISE-PLUS, an iPad and Mac textbook creation framework extended from Project RAISE that creates a unique and enriched experience engaging students of all learning backgrounds, while enabling teachers to customize textbook lessons specifically to their classroom needs.​
Manage and mentor a small team of five undergraduate developers within the larger organization.
Lead weekly team meetings, delegate tasks to team members.
Aid in the prioritization of feature development and project roadmap, taking into account feedback from key stakeholders.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description:
Contribute to Project INSITE, an interactive iOS textbook that teaches incarcerated children essential life skills needed for career advancement and support post-incarceration
Utilize XCode and SQL to create textbook pages as requested by content developers.
Find and fix bugs within the project to ensure a smooth user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Contributed UX improvements, rolled out library changes, and added acceptance tests while working with over 10 core internal HubSpot repositories used by over 1,000 software engineers that aid in building, deploying, and testing applications (REACT, JavaScript, Typescript)

Implemented a dashboard feature within a live deployment pipeline that provides users real-time information regarding the status of their automated acceptance tests, advancing the company’s strides towards continuous improvement and delivery

Achieved 2nd place in the company’s infrastructure-wide hackathon for a global search UI that utilizes multiple API services to search for users, documentation, apps, and more across infrastructure developer tools, improving tool discoverability and streamlining the developer experience at HubSpot.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience Design (UED) · JavaScript · TypeScript · HTML/CSS/Javascript · React.js · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked alongside senior software developers to contribute to Cloudforge Console and Cloudforge Marketplace.

Aided in the implementation of both the backend and frontend of a new feature that allows CloudForge Marketplace users to rate existing code skeletons and templates on a scale of 1-5 stars (REACT, DynamoDB).

Networked with Liberty product owners to learn about the product lifecycle and the product owner role within the insurance industry.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience Design (UED) · JavaScript · Node.js · GraphQL · React.js · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Capital One Software Engineering Summit
positions.description:
Achieved first place overall in the summit-wide hackathon for Project Fumble.
Attended technical workshops focused in iOS development, AR, AWS, Firebase, and Arduino.

positions.title: Assistant Librarian
positions.description:
Marketed library's many services to visitors and patrons through active communication.
Assisted patrons with library's computers and provided information on logging onto Internet.
Gained strong understanding of various methods for cataloging books and other materials.

Assisted with library workshop teaching fifth through eighth grade students the fundamentals of JavaScript.
Provided resources for students looking to learn more code outside of the classroom.

positions.title: Fulfillment Intern
positions.description:
Received and closed trouble tickets relating to hardware and software. Packaged and shipped important hardware to clients and company workers.
Updated firmware and software on company computers.
Attended daily huddle meetings.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Awarded lead graphic designer within the marketing team
•	Created and promoted marketing material utilizing Canva
•	Achieved a registration turnout of over 1,000 people
•	Designed a high-fidelity mockup of the TechTogether Boston website using Figma

Raised funds to donate to Amherst Survival Center by baking and selling loaves of Challah to the Amherst Community
Spearheaded the digitalization of all club processes, increasing the data available for analyzation used for club improvement 
Achieved an increase of over 100 club members from the start of the semester
